user_text: Perfect, that's done. I'm pretty tired, honestly.
text:
Moving—even just *planning* a move—is genuinely exhausting. Looking at a massive wall of tasks for a 2,400-mile relocation is a lot of mental load to take on at once. 

Go ahead and close the tab for tonight. You've got the hardest part of the planning out of your head and onto paper, and at 10 weeks out, you have plenty of time. 

Notice my last message cut off right before the room-by-room packing guide, the 8-week phone calendar, and the one-page printable moving day sheet—don't worry about those right now. Go get some rest, give the dog some pets, and whenever you have the bandwidth again tomorrow or this weekend, just reply here and I’ll drop the rest of the lists for you.
